sn14.9:1.2: This integrates the factors feeling and contact from the internal pentad ([sn14.4]()). Compared with other presentations (such as [mn18:16.1]()), it appears to do so incorrectly; we would expect contact, then feeling, perception, thought, desire, passion, and gains. Another sequence at [dn21:2.2.2]() also appears confused. [dn15:9.1]() has name and form, then contact, feeling, craving, searching, and gaining.
